judged_text: `feed_key` is computed (an SHA1 of the feed URL) but never used anywhere — the intended modified-since/etag caching is absent, so this is dead code and the poller re-processes every item every hour. Operators reading the code believe feed polling is keyed/cached; in reality each hourly run re-fetches and re-runs TopicEmbed.import for every feed item, relying entirely on the per-item sha1 comparison — deletion test: removing feed_key and its Digest::SHA1 require changes no behavior.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` computes `"feed-modified:#{Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)}"` and the file `require`s `digest/sha1`, but `feed_key` is never referenced by `execute` or `poll_feed`. The polling logic always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates `rss.items.each` calling `TopicEmbed.import(...)` for every item on each run, with no modified-since/etag or redis-based caching keyed by `feed_key`. Removing `feed_key` (and likely the SHA1 require) would not change behavior per the diff, making this dead/unfinished logic rather than a functional defect.
